topic: Copying and cleaning virtual session data
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on replicating historical session data for a specific client (Company 7939) onto virtual facilities. The goal was to ensure continuity of session metrics starting from November 1, 2024.

Initial analysis showed that the system had recently received a large volume of new session data. A decision was made to find and replicate these new sessions for the period spanning November 1, 2024, through February 11, 2025.

Furthermore, concerns were raised about the quality and potential inflation caused by old or 'virtual' links/sessions. It was agreed that dropping (dropping) these older virtual connections would be beneficial to prevent overly large values during future recalculations.
decisions: Replicate historical session data for Company 7939 starting from November 1, 2024.
Drop old/virtual links and sessions to improve accuracy in future calculations.
action_items: Complete the replication of new virtual session data by the next morning (or as a top priority).
